Detailed Description

Parameters describing a single linear transmission attached to a bot.

Mirrors superdex::experimental::LinearTransmissionParams with an added display name field and SReflect markup so it can live inside BotPrefab and round-trip through the bot's JSON serialization. The three joint arrays (jointIndices, jointCoefficients, jointAxisDisps) must always be the same length, with one entry per joint the transmission traverses. The remaining fields are inherited from BotTransmissionPrefab which inherits superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams so that one displacement-control actuator can be configured alongside each transmission.
